OBSERVED SO FAR:
 - behaviour weights: train_rqvae.py:256-299 _build_successor_attraction (train-split directed adjacent pairs, (indeg+1)/(n+2), clip [.25,4], normalise) -> bound into each level via FrechetCodebook.set_weights (train_rqvae.py:328-332).
 - curved path: layers.py:140-149 curved branch computes point=exp_0(latent), weights=frechet.weight_of(item_ids), cost=frechet.distances(point,codebook)=poincare_distance (frechet_poincare.py:133-141), argmin assignment, remember(); commitment at layers.py:168 uses weights*poincare_distance^2 -> encoder gradient; Frechet accumulate/apply (frechet_poincare.py:149-201) moves the slot with weighted tangent mean -> codebook -> SID.

CHECK (a) behaviour x geometry fidelity - RESULT: NEEDS_FIX (blocking).
Path exercised: train_rqvae.py:256-299 builds the training-only successor attraction ((indeg+1)/(n+2), clip [.25,4]) from TRAIN_FILE only (:317,:328) and binds it into every level (:329-332); layers.py:146-149 weight_of -> frechet.distances -> argmin -> remember; layers.py:168 weighted commitment; frechet_poincare.py:149-201 accumulate/apply; train_rqvae.py:440-448 applies the slot move (DDP all_reduce of tangent_sum/weight_sum). So one connected pathway exists (weights reach both the objective and the slot estimator, curve reaches assignment, commitment and the step), and both switches sit inside it (frechet_poincare.py:128,135,145,170,192).
DEFECT (blocking): model/frechet_poincare.py:31-32 writes the Mobius sum with a minus on the second term: num=(1+2c<xy>+c||y||^2)x - (1-c||x||^2)y. The standard (and the repo's own model/utils.py:34) form is '+ (1-c||x||^2)y'. With the minus, poincare_distance(x,x) is NOT 0: diff = mobius_add(-x,x) = -2x/(1-||x||^2), so ||diff||=2r/(1-r^2). r=0.2 -> 0.4167 -> d=0.887; r=0.5 -> 1.333 -> clamped to 1-1e-7 -> d=16.1 (the maximum). It is also asymmetric, and monotonicity inverts: for r=0.5 the d between identical directions is 16.1 while between antipodal directions it is 0.663. So the executed op is not the Poincare distance the proposal names; the argmin assignment, the weighted commitment and log_at/exp_at (which are no longer inverse, and not idempotent: log_at(c,c)!=0) all compute a wrong object. Reproduction: p=torch.tensor([[0.2,0.0]]); print(poincare_distance(p,p)) -> 0.887 (expected 0.0); p=[[0.5,0.0]] -> 16.1. Correction: use num=(1+2c*xy+c*y2)*x + (1-c*x2)*y (as model/utils.py:34) or compute the distance from the closed form with a d(p,p)=0 unit check.

FINAL ANSWER - VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX.
(a) behaviour x geometry fidelity: NEEDS_FIX (blocking). Path is connected (train_rqvae.py:256-332 weights -> layers.py:146-149 -> layers.py:168 commitment -> frechet_poincare.py:149-201 -> train_rqvae.py:440-448), but model/frechet_poincare.py:31 writes the Mobius sum with '- (1-c||x||^2)y' instead of '+'. Hence poincare_distance(x,x) = 2*atanh(2r/(1-r^2)) is non-zero: 0.887 at r=0.2, 16.1 (max) at r>=0.5; asymmetric, order inverted (identical directions 16.1 vs antipodal 0.663 at r=0.5); log_at/exp_at not inverse (log_at(c,c)!=0). The executed op is not the Poincare distance, so argmin assignment, weighted commitment and the Frechet step are wrong. Repro: poincare_distance(torch.tensor([[0.2,0.0]]), same) -> 0.887. Correction: use '+ (1-c*x2)*y' (as model/utils.py:34) and assert d(p,p)=0.
(b) trainability: NEEDS_FIX (blocking). Gradient wiring is right (layers.py:145/168 -> encoder; embed.weight.grad nulled at train_rqvae.py:433-435; switches use_behaviour at frechet_poincare.py:128 and use_curvature at :135/145/170/192 are live). But the wrong subtraction gives ||diff||=2r/(1-r^2), so at r>=0.5 the atanh clamp (frechet_poincare.py:87-88) sits at 1-1e-7 with zero derivative: commitment is a constant 259 with zero encoder gradient exactly for well-fitting pairs, and apply() is not idempotent, so the slot is moved away from its own members. Loss stays finite so the check at train_rqvae.py:425 does not fire. Correction: fix mobius_add and keep BALL_EPS so ||diff||<1, plus an idempotence check. Minor finding: frechet_poincare.py:164-200 loops 256 slots x 3 levels with 3 host syncs each per step (~2300 syncs/step); vectorise with scatter_add.
(c) integration: PASS. Entry point _launch_via_torchrun 559-589 with SINGLE_GPU_ENV="GENREC_SINGLE_GPU" early return at :563-567 -> main() world_size 1 (:311-313); frozen data paths :61-62; SID export _extend_collisions :208-221 + uniqueness :545-546 + np.save/item_sids.json keyed by global item id :548-551; writes only RESULT_DIR/LOG_DIR (:58-67); DDP all_reduce of the step sums :445-447. Check a (behaviour x geometry fidelity): PASS. Path: train_rqvae.py:256-300 builds training-only successor weights (indeg+1)/(n_v+2), clip [0.25,4], self-transitions dropped; bound at train_rqvae.py:329-333 -> layers.py:140-149 (exp_0 to ball, weight_of, curved argmin, remember) -> frechet_poincare.py:159-211 (per-slot weighted tangent average + exp_at) -> model.py:40-80 writes the slots -> the moved slot decides the exported SID because get_indices is called with item_ids=arange(N) (train_rqvae.py:538-541), so no Euclidean fallback at export. The same weights enter the commitment (layers.py:168-170). Both switches are real: use_behaviour=False -> unit weights (frechet_poincare.py:138-139); use_curvature=False -> Euclidean cost/commitment/step (145-150,183,206).

Check b (trainability): PASS with one minor finding. Weighted curved commitment is differentiable in point=exp_0(latent) so gradient reaches the encoder; codebook is deliberately detached (layers.py:168,174; train_rqvae.py:434-437) per spec; all maps clamped (frechet_poincare.py:21-23,39,42-53,77,97-98), non-finite slots skipped (199,208); loss finiteness checked (train_rqvae.py:426). Minor: exp_0 (frechet_poincare.py:56-59) does not clamp, so ||e||>=18 in float32 puts a point exactly on the sphere and the atanh clamp (line 98) zeroes that sample's commitment gradient (distance stays finite ~16). Does not fire at the observed scale (radius ~0.9). Correction: wrap exp_0's return in clamp_ball.

Check c (integration): NEEDS_FIX. Result dir (train_rqvae.py:59), frozen data (61-62), SID export (545-551), SINGLE_GPU_ENV branch (73, 564-568) and the stage2 launcher handover (581-589) are fine.
BLOCKING: train_rqvae.py:344-345 wraps with find_unused_parameters=False, but in the curved branch nothing yields a gradient for layer.embed.weight: commitment uses .detach() (layers.py:168), straight-through detaches the decoder input (174), mse uses x_q.detach() (170), assignment is argmin. So the codebook param never fires a DDP hook and the second-iteration prepare_for_backward raises "Expected to have finished reduction in the prior iteration... parameters that were not used in producing loss". The four-card run aborts; the single-card smoke misses it (world_size==1 skips DDP, line 340). Fix: set self.embed.weight.requires_grad_(False) when frechet is enabled (the Frechet step owns it and writes via .data.copy_) or pass find_unused_parameters=True.
MINOR: train_rqvae.py:398-404 initialises the codebook on rank 0 only and never broadcasts it although embed is a DDP-wrapped parameter (DDP syncs params only at construction), so ranks 1-3 train against their own xavier codebook and the Frechet step preserves the divergence. Inherited from the frozen Stage 2 file; fix with dist.broadcast(layer.embed.weight.data, 0) after init. Not the blocking item.
